source_guidance_clarification: Source interpretation and ambiguities: the methods continuation on physical PDF p3 gives a d_norm display range of -0.18 to 1.4 and labels it a.u.; p4 gives -0.676 to 1.415 and labels it angstrom. d_norm is a normalized distance quantity; the two ranges and the dimensional labels are inconsistent as reported. Record the definition and display settings actually used, and do not treat either printed interval as a certified numerical target or tolerance. In section 3.2, the S(7) C6-H6...O3 motif is intramolecular, whereas the C8-H8...O3 and C12-H12B...O2 contacts form the intermolecular R2^2(9) motif. Verify source labels and symmetry operations against authenticated coordinates before using them. The red/blue triangles on the shape-index surface and flat curvedness regions (pp4-6, Figs2-5) are the authors' evidence for a pi-packing interpretation; they do not measure stabilization energies or establish an energetic ordering. These are disclosed source claims to assess, not required outcomes.
completion_boundary: Completion and coverage: the full question concerns interactions in the authenticated observed crystal. An isolated monomer, a cell-only model or a report of the missing CIF covers only a prerequisite or limited molecular property, not the packing question. Reducing addressed_scope does not convert that partial evidence into whole-task completion or full credit for unaddressed criteria. Credit independently valid parts according to what they establish. An adequately investigated, evidence-supported inability to distinguish interactions can be a scientific conclusion; unavailable coordinates or failed calculations cannot establish it. While the mandatory authenticated CIF remains absent, this task is blocked and ineligible for complete capability ranking; this is an operator instruction, not a claim of enforced scheduling.
